name: hollow-signal-typecheck
description: Offline Luau type-check of src/ against Roblox API definitions (no Studio needed).

scripts.defs: curl -sSL -o globalTypes.d.luau https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JohnnyMorganz/luau-lsp/main/scripts/globalTypes.d.luau && node gen-defs.mjs globalTypes.d.luau roblox.d.luau
